title.vi: Quy chế Giải thích pháp luật (Công báo) 2025
title.th: ข้อบังคับการตีความ (ราชกิจจานุเบกษา) 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Interpretation (Gazette) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 9 March 2025.

2.—(1) For the purposes of section 48(2), (4)(a) and (6) of the Act, the prescribed website is https://www.egazette.gov.sg.
[S 60/2026 wef 06/02/2026]
(2) In the event that the prescribed website mentioned in paragraph (1) is unavailable, the prescribed website is https://www.egazette2.gov.sg.
[S 60/2026 wef 06/02/2026]
